description: Dataset for GIS-Based Tropical Cyclone Vulnerability Assessment Using the Analytical Hierarchy Process in Dar es Salaam Metropolitan City, Tanzania is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. Title Dataset for GIS-Based Tropical Cyclone Vulnerability Assessment Using the Analytical Hierarchy Process in Dar es Salaam Metropolitan City, Tanzania Description This dataset supports the study “Vulnerability assessment of tropical cyclone in coastal cities using GIS-based Analytic Hierarchy Process: The case of coastal Dar es Salaam Metropolitan City, Tanzania”. Coverage: Tanzania. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Climate Change, Vulnerability, Tropical Cyclone. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
